title: SEEDS: weather ensembles generated with a diffusion model
summary: The model produces 256 members at 2° resolution every three minutes on a TPU and matches or exceeds the operational GEFS ensemble (31 members) on rank histograms, RMSE and CRPS. For the Lisbon heatwave (July 2022), with 16,384 members, none of GEFS’s 31 members was as warm as observed. One extreme case; depends on physics-based forecasts as seeds; published in Science Advances.

evidence.tested: The ensemble was compared with the operational GEFS (31 members) using rank histograms, RMSE and CRPS, and with a 16,384-member ensemble for the Lisbon heatwave of July 2022.
evidence.unknown: The heatwave comparisons are single examples, the model depends on physics-based seed forecasts, and the page has no explicit limitations section.
evidence.ai_role: A denoising diffusion model generates large weather-forecast ensembles from one or two operational forecasts.
